candidates.observation: The opening synopsis introduces the numeric r=20 log2 m, allowance L, a fixed-time joint event, heavy columns and the union bound before a column/address example exists. The broad mechanism is understandable, but the precise event is an opaque miniature proof. Consider moving the fixed-time event and coefficients to a first-proof map while retaining the mL versus sqrt(m) synopsis.

The paragraph says the proof has two branches 'after the same total function is constructed' but immediately lists §3 ingredients before §4 construction. This is a dependency description rather than publication order; say so or order the sentence by construction then branches.

The route requires a source-display audit and imported lower bound before the reader has seen the construction. The route itself is longer and harder to retain than the main proof preview; a compact prerequisite table could distinguish imported and locally rebuilt ingredients without repeated nested section ranges.

Four route descriptions, five direct questions, §1.1's mechanism and a second dependency index precede the model development. Most links are individually useful but jointly produce a high navigation tax; consolidate repeated entry guidance while preserving full routes in one location.

'A circuit transcript in the cell certifies the values' first asks an outsider to accept a cheap certification of a classically hard function. A short bridge should distinguish querying a supplied transcript from computing it and flag the one-sided definition that makes the certification possible.

Multiple incompatible numbering namespaces impose a persistent lookup cost. The explanation is precise but the reader must remember that Lemma4.1 belongs to §6.1 and bare equations to another paper; add role names at subsequent lemma citations or adopt local named labels consistently.

The two maps E and J appear simultaneously in a dense bridge paragraph; the reader must infer why one is not enough before the following proof explains it. A tiny query-prefix diagram or one sentence stating that E may scramble the oracle address while J must intertwine the oracle would make the strengthened invariant usable immediately.

The model section repeatedly switches between a mathematical convention and implementation-specific formal transport. A consistent compact 'formal comparison' block could let a mathematician follow the model continuously while retaining all implementation details for the formal-methods route.

The edition warning after the parity calculation is longer than the parity conclusion and interrupts the transition to the ingredient. A short footnote with the exact convention difference would preserve necessary citation fidelity while allowing the main proof to advance.

The ingredient preview is useful but immediately introduces a numeric threshold13669k² and exact circuit coefficient200 before the design need is operational. Distinguish the simple interface used by §4 from a separate quantitative parameter line so readers can first retain what each guarantee does.

The exact S identity is introduced as a recovered constructor count, but the reader receives only one large expression. A small accounting table assigning each summand to transforms, sign layers, final sum and comparisons would make the claimed equality reconstructible without source archaeology.

The independent-entry convention repeats definition, normalization, orthogonality, promise and cap in substantial detail shortly after they were proved. Mark a short boxed 'entry assumptions' summary and refer within the complete route, keeping an optional standalone version separate if duplication is a deliberate publishing requirement.

Credit and novelty appear as a long paragraph containing raw derivatives, Fourier levels and a kernel not yet defined. Separate the short provenance claim needed now from the technical comparison after F24, where the reader can evaluate it.

The unusual algebraic bias transform is presented without a design derivation. The stated jobs explain why boundedness and integration by parts matter, but not why choosing Psi=1/(2sqrt(2+x²)) produces the useful phi. A short design line deriving phi=xPsi−Psi prime from the chosen kernel would improve reconstructibility without adding a theorem.

The notation nu1 is called the analytic comparison law, while nearby prose later calls it the hard distribution and §6 will introduce a different promised hard law mu. A persistent two-row distribution glossary would prevent conflating the all-cube Gaussian comparison with the planting input law.

The single common s-star is mathematically enough, but it hides that F33 can also be obtained by integrating a uniform-in-s derivative bound over[0,1]. Consider the integral form as the primary bridge; it removes an auxiliary existential parameter that otherwise needs an explanatory paragraph, while retaining the mean-value observation optionally.

The near-identical optional threshold ceiling introduces another exact constant immediately after the main numerical assembly. It adds bookkeeping without changing a reader's use of the theorem; move this refinement to a numerical note or parameter appendix.

The complete chronological reader reaches the usable three-property interface only after roughly1,200 source lines of Forrelation development, before any complete addressed board. A two-part architecture could introduce the §3.17 contract early, complete §§4–7, and then rebuild the analytic hardness engine. This preserves a complete proof while making every technical lemma answer a previously encountered need. The current route instructions permit skipping, but do not repair the publication-order burden.

The corresponding four-column examples in the reasoning record and exposition use different statistic magnitudes and therefore different decoder laws. The warning is correct, but requiring readers to carry this nonidentity weakens the shared example's teaching role. Prefer one common board or a compact explicit conversion table.

The example's mathematical conclusion is interrupted by very long nested historical return paths and rerun commands. A stable asset index or a brief evidence note would preserve reproducibility while letting the example conclude at the level of its mathematical lesson.

The phrase about total surviving weight 'at least halves in expectation' leaves a momentary direction-of-inequality ambiguity. State that expected remaining total weight is at most half of current weight, and later connect the drift equation to that sentence.

The exact pivot-law proof is followed by several formal correspondence, padded-budget, and finite-law restatements before the concrete decoder/comparator resumes. Each distinction is careful, but their cumulative placement interrupts the algorithmic arc. A single paired ordinary-proof/formal-interface subsection after the full evaluator would preserve these distinctions with less repeated state reconstruction.

The source paragraph gives a full alternative Drucker substitution, its replacement error term, and a Shaltiel comparison between the direct-product proof and the planting argument. It is valuable provenance, but at this exact transition I must retain the simulator contract while processing an unused alternate theorem. Moving the quantitative alternative to a clearly linked source appendix would keep the main lower-bound chain easier to follow.

The planting toy switches both its partial function and its row/column numbering from the earlier construction example. The XOR simplification has a clear purpose, but changing one-based to zero-based labels adds an avoidable translation exactly when the simulator must track two clocks and three kinds of data. Keep one coordinate-label convention across worked boards.

The erased-zero estimate is proved three ways before the planted-cell reduction resumes. The alternatives are honestly marked optional and distinguish formal scope well, but the chronological argument still spends substantial space on an already sufficient term. Retain the main early/late proof here and place the alternative induction/refinement beside the formal-route appendix or in a compact optional supplement.

The catalogue repeatedly refers to section3.18, including the Forrelation source-version discrepancy. On this chronological encounter I recall section3 ending with its supplier bundle/source note before section4 and cannot identify that numbered heading. Check whether the printed section labels and forr_references anchor still designate an actual section; this is provisional pending a later link/heading audit.

A full execution-history archive intervenes between source comparisons and the current formal-evidence explanation. Its repeated dates, counts, byte identities, wrapper qualifications, and superseded comments require substantial version bookkeeping. For a reading manuscript, keep a compact provenance timeline plus one durable archival link; retain the full archive as a separate evidence artifact.
